description.value: Jarry's Market is a local supermarket serving the Tsawwassen community near the BC Ferries terminal and the US border crossing — a strategically located resupply point for touring cyclists on the southern BC coast. Its position in Tsawwassen makes it a natural stop for cyclists arriving or departing by ferry or crossing the border at Peace Arch.
